method: Robot kinematics at the three nut releases over the rod (GELLO teleoperation on the real UR5e, 2026-11-22): nut bottom = flange position + 0.225 m along the tool z axis; where the gripper opens over the rod the nut rests on it. Releases at about (-82, -806, 164), (-97, -812, 187) and (-87, -811, 172) mm. docs/media/videos/registration_demo.mp4 shows one of them.
status: confirmed by the author against external measurements (2026-11-22)
